audit.whatIsWrong: Two phase reasons argue the opposite of the side printed above them. phases[0] is 'Level 1 — Akshan 3/10' but reads 'Your AA + W chop wins most level-1 exchanges' (and Crippling Strike is not even available at level 1). phases[4] is 'Level 6 — Akshan 3/10' but reads 'Noxian Guillotine turns any 5-stack trade into a kill'.
audit.why: The chart says he owns those two stages and the sentence underneath says you do. Both stages are genuinely his — level 1 to Avengerang's 850-range double hit, level 6 to Comeuppance scaling off your missing health.
audit.corrected: phases[0] rewritten to Avengerang's out-and-back poke; phases[4] rewritten to Comeuppance and the minion-block answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is attributed to your Guillotine beating 'his passive shields', and the late spike to 'global R revives'. Comeuppance is not a revive and it is not global — it is 2500 range and stores bullets that scale off missing health. The resurrect belongs to Going Rogue's Scoundrel kill.
audit.why: Two different abilities were merged into one wrong spike, so a player never learns which ability to actually respect at 6.
audit.corrected: Comeuppance (100/85/70, 2500 range, missing-health bullets) is the level-6 threat; Going Rogue (18/14/10/6/2) carries the Scoundrel resurrect and the camouflage roam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions decide this lane and none of them are on the page. Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook INTO TERRAIN, so it does not exist in the open middle of the lane. He is knocked off the swing when he collides with a champion — standing in the path cancels it. And Comeuppance hits only the first champion, minion or structure in the line, so a single minion eats the entire ultimate.
audit.why: Riot's own text says all three: 'fires a grappling hook into terrain', 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain', and 'dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit'. The page instead describes Heroic Swing as a generic 'dash + camera swing escape'.
audit.corrected: Fight him away from walls; body-block the swing; keep a minion between you and his Comeuppance channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing is named as the tracked cooldown eight times without a number anywhere.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, Avengerang is 9/8/7/6/5, Going Rogue is 18/14/10/6/2 and Comeuppance is 100/85/70. Against Apprehend's 26s at rank 1 those numbers are the entire trade calculus.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every dosFull/dontsFull description is shared boilerplate unrelated to its title: 'Land the Q outer ring to heal' is explained by 'Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full combo immediately.'
audit.why: The reader is told what to do and then given a reason for a different action.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title.

edits.before: He kites your pull — freeze near tower and E-pull the step-up, then run him down.
edits.after: Heroic Swing needs a wall — fight mid-lane, pull his step-up, and run him down.

edits.before: Your AA + W chop wins most level-1 exchanges, and every auto starts the Hemorrhage clock. Trade on his last-hits but don't chase past the wave.
edits.after: Avengerang hits going out and coming back from 850 while you have no gap-closer at all. Soak it, last-hit at melee range, and refuse the trade.

edits.before: Bleed management decides the lane: every trade should end at 3+ stacks or not happen. Track Heroic Swing before you commit the pull.
edits.after: Bleed management decides the lane: every trade ends at 3+ stacks or does not happen. Heroic Swing needs a wall — fight him in the open lane.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine turns any 5-stack trade into a kill. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Comeuppance stores bullets scaling off your missing health, so his poke converts to a kill. Stand behind a minion — it hits the first target.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness — the run-down you couldn't finish before is now lethal. Force fights on Heroic Swing's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness — the run-down you couldn't finish is now lethal. Force fights inside Heroic Swing's 18s rank-1 gap.

edits.before: Weave autos for Hemorrhage and trade around your AA + W chop — you out-stat almost everyone level 1-3. Hold E until Akshan missteps; the pull into Q outer ring is the whole lane. Don't chase past the wave into Heroic Swing.
edits.after: Weave autos for Hemorrhage, but levels 1-2 belong to Avengerang's 850-range double hit. Hold Apprehend until he steps up; the pull into an outer-ring Decimate is the whole lane. Fight in open lane where he has no wall to hook.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing (18/16.5/15/13.5/12): hooks into terrain only, and a champion collision knocks him off it mid-flight. - Comeuppance (100/85/70): hits the first champion, minion or structure in line — a minion eats it. - Apprehend (26s at rank 1): never spend it on chip damage.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 and needs terrain to hook — in open lane he has nothing to spend.

edits.before: Pull Akshan as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.
edits.after: Apprehend is 535 and Avengerang is 850, so the pull only exists when he steps in to last-hit. Take that step, W-slow, and outer-ring Decimate.

edits.before: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full combo immediately.
edits.after: Only the outer blade heals you — aim past him, not through the wave.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refusing it removes half his win condition.
edits.after: Colliding with a champion knocks him off Heroic Swing — stand in its path instead.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Decimate's outer edge is the damage and the heal; the handle through a minion wave gives you neither.

edits.before: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1. Whiff it and you have no engage for 26 seconds while he pokes you with a 9s Avengerang from 850.

edits.before: Once you have W and E, wait for Akshan to whiff or commit his Q boomerang, then E-pull him out of dash range and Q-inner + W. He can't kite five Hemorrhage stacks once you're on top of him.
edits.after: Once you have W and E, wait for Avengerang to commit, then Apprehend him away from the wall he swings off and inner Decimate + W. He cannot kite five Hemorrhage stacks once you are on him.

edits.before: Your R execute answers his poke-heavy pattern: chunk him with a full combo, stack Hemorrhage, and the Guillotine finishes before his passive shields save him. Deny his roam by shoving and threatening dives.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine answers his poke pattern: full combo, stack Hemorrhage, and true damage finishes before Dirty Fighting's every-third-hit shield saves him. Deny his roam by shoving and threatening dives.

edits.before: With Stridebreaker/Trinity you close the gap his E swing wants to keep open — E-pull, dash, and delete him. His squishy AD-caster body folds to your bleed once you connect.
edits.after: Stridebreaker closes the gap Heroic Swing wants to hold — pull, dash, delete. The swing hooks into terrain, so a fight in the middle of the lane leaves him nothing to grapple.

edits.before: Skill-dependent: Akshan brings global R revives and pick threat, but in a straight 1v1 your bleed still wins if you land E. Fights hinge on whether he can kite with E-swing and W camouflage or you catch him.
edits.after: Skill-dependent: Going Rogue's Scoundrel resurrect and Comeuppance's 2500-range bullets bring pick threat, but 1v1 your bleed wins if Apprehend lands. It hinges on whether he keeps a wall between you.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are Akshan's: his Q boomerang hits on the way out and back for free ranged poke while you have no gap-closer yet, and his E-swing keeps him spacing you. Farm safe, soak the poke, and don't force a trade you can't finish.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are Akshan's: Avengerang hits going out and coming back from 850 while you have no gap-closer, and Heroic Swing keeps him spaced. Farm safe, soak the poke, and don't force a trade you can't finish.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 flip to you the instant W and E come online — E-pull him out of his dash, land Q-inner + Crippling Strike, and 5-stack Hemorrhage plus R execute end it. Punish every Q he throws by stepping in during the boomerang's return.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 flip to you the instant W and E come online — Apprehend him off his swing, land inner Decimate plus Crippling Strike, and 5-stack Hemorrhage plus Guillotine end it. Step in while Avengerang is still travelling back.

edits.before: Late game is a skill check: Akshan's global R, camouflage and E-swing kiting give him map value and escape, but if you land your E in a 1v1 your bleed and Guillotine still win. It comes down to who lands their key ability first.
edits.after: Late game is a skill check: Comeuppance's 2500 range, Going Rogue camouflage and wall-hooked swings give him map value, but land Apprehend in a 1v1 and your bleed and Guillotine still win. Whoever lands first takes it.

edits.after: Akshan-favoured: Avengerang hits out and back from 850 while you have no gap-closer at all.

edits.after: Akshan-favoured: at 2 Heroic Swing holds the spacing while Avengerang chunks you.

edits.after: You-favoured: Stridebreaker closes the gap Heroic Swing wants to hold, letting you delete him.

edits.before: Skill: it's even late — his global R and kiting vs your bleed hinge on who lands their key ability.
edits.after: Skill: even late — Comeuppance and wall-hooked kiting vs your bleed, decided by who lands first.

edits.before: Bait his Q boomerang and E-pull during its return travel
edits.after: Bait Avengerang and Apprehend during its return travel

edits.after: Stack Hemorrhage to 5 and execute before Dirty Fighting shields him
